529-969-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4499-6752-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6926-7893.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6926-7893.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-4677-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4677-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

5747-6243-6495--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
5747-6243-6495--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
5747-6243-6495--123.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4067-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

654-1308-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7933.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cold-Blooded Crew.
When Cold-Blooded Crew dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cold-Blooded Crew enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-2445.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

5078-6918-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat

240-5147-5470-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2034-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2042-2894-6033-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2042-2894-6033-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Golgari Brownscale. Then, the draw will be replaced by Golgari Brownscale's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Golgari Brownscale from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-5170-6094-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4955-6556-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4955-6556-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1409-1887-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1409-1887-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
When Avatar Kuruk enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

483-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

944-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, Airbending Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

132-4222-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
132-4222-5527.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

339-677-969-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

944-4484-4871-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-4484-4871-5643-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-4484-4871-5643-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1429-3967-6792.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

567-3197-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3197-4017.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1350-4010-6633-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-6633-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1020-1117-4030-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2043-2557-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Boommobile that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
When the Boommobile tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2043-2557-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

803-1486-1753-5475.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
803-1486-1753-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
803-1486-1753-5475.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

144-628-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

997-2850--71.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the ability from step 1, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1844-2191-6085.notablePrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 7.
1844-2191-6085.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying {3}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards and give control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Altanak an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1548-5461.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1548-5461.description:
Activate Calamity's saddle ability by tapping Port Razer, causing Calamity to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Calamity as an attacker.
Calamity triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Port Razer, and repeating the process once for any nonlegendary creature that saddled Calamity this turn.
Deal combat damage using the Port Razer token(s).
Each Port Razer who has not attacked the opponent this turn triggers, causing you to untap each creature you control and to get that many additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

3996-4050-4772.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting six +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.

2034-3374-3870.notablePrerequisites: Phantom Nomad does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-3374-3870.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Phantom Nomad persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantom Nomad, adding {C}{C}.
When Phantom Nomad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its first ability.
Repeat.

3259-3349-4478.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3259-3349-4478.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Glissa triggers, creating two Incubator artifact tokens with two +1/+1 counters on them.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the beginning of your next combat phase, Glissa triggers, transforming all Incubators you control into 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creatures.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1368-4530-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4530-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Ambassador Laquatus by paying {3}, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.
